en: A standard wheelbarrow acts as a second-class lever that multiplies your lifting force by two to three times.
A block and tackle pulley system with four rope segments provides a mechanical advantage of exactly four, multiplying your pulling force by four.
Ice has a friction coefficient of about 0.03, making it roughly one hundred times slipperier than dry asphalt.
The Moon's gravity is only 1.6 meters per second squared, which is about one-sixth of Earth's 9.8 meters per second squared.
A typical neodymium fridge magnet produces a magnetic field of about 0.5 Tesla, which is 10,000 times stronger than Earth's natural magnetic field.
The Large Hadron Collider uses superconducting electromagnets cooled to negative 271 degrees Celsius to generate magnetic fields of 8.3 Tesla.
A single lightning bolt carries about 300 million volts, roughly one million times more than a standard 230-volt electrical outlet.
A standard copper wire conducts electricity with nearly zero ohms of resistance, while a 1-centimeter rubber eraser resists current flow with over 10 billion ohms.
Light travels at 300,000 kilometers per second in a vacuum, fast enough to circle Earth's equator 7.5 times in one second.
Sound travels through water at 1,480 meters per second, more than four times faster than its 343 meters per second speed in air.
Water's specific heat capacity is 4.18 Joules per gram per degree Celsius, requiring about four times more heat energy to warm than dry sand.
One kilogram of body fat stores 37,000 kilojoules of chemical potential energy, enough to heat 80 liters of water from freezing to boiling.
